== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Tatooine: Docking Bay 94]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/tatooine_docking_bay_94__lightside_japanese_white_border/50609 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/f7d54764f7524b17a9127636d8b16aea/IMG_20220607_0136.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 1072, 766)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>5e48bb066dacba0fe3b4fe45024f797215b5804c5551571e4e0f0d92943f5e8e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
